questions.explanation: 根据上文的“inspired by...”，作者在iPad上开始创作，几个小时后（Hours later），顺理成章地“完成”了第一篇短篇小说。wrap up意为“圆满完成，结束”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(showed off)：语境句：He showed off his new car to his friends. 固定搭配：show off, show off one's skills
B(pulled over)：语境句：The police officer asked the driver to pull over. 固定搭配：pull over, pull over to the side
C(cut off)：语境句：Our electricity was cut off because we didn't pay the bill. 固定搭配：cut off, cut off the supply
D(wrapped up)：语境句：We wrapped up the meeting early today. 固定搭配：wrap up, wrap up a project

questions.explanation: 作者仅用几个小时就完成了小说，由此可见作者对此充满热情，因此写作“很快”就成了他钟爱的爱好。quickly符合逻辑递进关系。
questions.supplement:
A(slowly)：语境句：The ice slowly melted in the sun. 固定搭配：slowly but surely, move slowly
B(openly)：语境句：She spoke openly about her struggles with anxiety. 固定搭配：speak openly, openly admit
C(quickly)：语境句：He quickly adapted to the new environment. 固定搭配：act quickly, learn quickly
D(carefully)：语境句：Please read the instructions carefully before starting. 固定搭配：listen carefully, think carefully

questions.explanation: 根据上文的“inspired”、“beloved hobby”，最初写作带给作者的是“兴奋”和“热情”。随着年龄增长，加上后文提到的自我怀疑，这种“兴奋感（excitement）”开始消退。
questions.supplement:
A(hope)：语境句：Never give up hope, even in the darkest times. 固定搭配：lose hope, in the hope of
B(surprise)：语境句：To my surprise, he passed the exam easily. 固定搭配：in surprise, take sb. by surprise
C(curiosity)：语境句：Curiosity drove him to explore the mysterious cave. 固定搭配：out of curiosity, satisfy one's curiosity
D(excitement)：语境句：The children could hardly contain their excitement. 固定搭配：with excitement, generate excitement

questions.explanation: 句中“what once felt like a creative outlet became a source of...”存在前后对比。曾经是创造力的发泄口，现在由于自我怀疑和与他人比较，变成了“压力（stress）”的来源。
questions.supplement:
A(relief)：语境句：It was a huge relief to know they were safe. 固定搭配：breathe a sigh of relief, to one's relief
B(truth)：语境句：To tell you the truth, I didn't like the movie. 固定搭配：tell the truth, face the truth
C(inspiration)：语境句：Nature has always been a great source of inspiration for her. 固定搭配：draw inspiration from, a source of inspiration
D(stress)：语境句：Yoga is a great way to relieve stress. 固定搭配：under stress, relieve stress

questions.explanation: 上文描述了写作从快乐变成压力的过程，作者总结说“这种转变（shift）经常发生”。shift指态度、情况或重心的转变，契合题意。
questions.supplement:
A(shift)：语境句：There has been a significant shift in public opinion. 固定搭配：make a shift, a shift in focus
B(accident)：语境句：He was severely injured in a car accident. 固定搭配：by accident, traffic accident
C(blessing)：语境句：Having a supportive family is a true blessing. 固定搭配：a blessing in disguise, count one's blessings
D(adjustment)：语境句：It took some time to make the adjustment to living abroad. 固定搭配：make an adjustment, a minor adjustment

questions.explanation: 空后同位语解释了该词的含义：“a way to relax ourselves”（一种放松自己的方式）。escape在这里指“逃避（现实压力）、放松身心的方式”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(growth)：语境句：Economic growth is essential for the country's development. 固定搭配：economic growth, personal growth
B(escape)：语境句：Reading provides an escape from the pressures of daily life. 固定搭配：a narrow escape, escape from reality
C(focus)：语境句：The focus of this meeting is on improving customer service. 固定搭配：focus on, main focus
D(commitment)：语境句：Marriage requires a huge emotional commitment. 固定搭配：make a commitment, commitment to

questions.explanation: 根据后文“there’s an expectation to perform at a high level”（人们期望有高水平的表现），可知社会压力要求我们在爱好上也必须“表现优异（excel）”。
questions.supplement:
A(live)：语境句：She lived a long and happy life. 固定搭配：live up to, live a... life
B(struggle)：语境句：Many young people struggle to find a stable job. 固定搭配：struggle with, struggle to do sth.
C(excel)：语境句：He has always excelled in foreign languages. 固定搭配：excel in/at, strive to excel
D(contribute)：语境句：Everyone should contribute to protecting the environment. 固定搭配：contribute to, make a contribution

questions.explanation: 前文列举了“painting, playing an instrument”，这些都属于业余爱好或追求。pursuit在此意为“事业、消遣、爱好（常指需花时间和精力的事）”。
questions.supplement:
A(ideas)：语境句：We brainstormed some creative ideas for the project. 固定搭配：come up with an idea, exchange ideas
B(pursuits)：语境句：She enjoys outdoor pursuits like hiking and cycling. 固定搭配：leisure pursuits, in pursuit of
C(distraction)：语境句：I can't study here; there are too many distractions. 固定搭配：a distraction from, provide a distraction
D(ambition)：语境句：His ultimate ambition is to run his own business. 固定搭配：achieve one's ambition, full of ambition

questions.explanation: 前文提到经常回到写作这个爱好，后文提到“自我怀疑的时刻”，两者是让步/转折关系：“尽管（in spite of）有自我怀疑的时刻”。
questions.supplement:
A(by means of)：语境句：Thoughts are expressed by means of words. 固定搭配：by means of communication, by all means
B(with respect to)：语境句：The two groups are very similar with respect to age. 固定搭配：with respect to, in respect of
C(in spite of)：语境句：He went out in spite of the heavy rain. 固定搭配：in spite of oneself, in spite of the fact that
D(in search of)：语境句：Many people moved to the city in search of better jobs. 固定搭配：go in search of, in search of truth

questions.explanation: “the constant drive for perfection”意为“不断追求完美的动力/渴望”。drive在这里作名词，意为“强烈的愿望，驱动力”，符合由爱好变为负担的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(drive)：语境句：Her drive for success helped her overcome many obstacles. 固定搭配：drive for perfection, sex drive
B(doubt)：语境句：There is no doubt that he is the best player on the team. 固定搭配：without doubt, beyond doubt
C(supply)：语境句：The water supply has been cut off due to the storm. 固定搭配：in short supply, food supply
D(imagination)：语境句：The story captured the imagination of children everywhere. 固定搭配：beyond imagination, lack of imagination

questions.explanation: 句意：对完美的追求把写作从“热爱（passion）”变成了一项苦差事（chore）。passion与chore形成鲜明对比，呼应文章开头提到的beloved hobby。
questions.supplement:
A(story)：语境句：Grandpa told us a fascinating bedtime story. 固定搭配：tell a story, make a long story short
B(passion)：语境句：Teaching is not just a job for her; it's a passion. 固定搭配：have a passion for, pursue one's passion
C(challenge)：语境句：Climbing the mountain was a real challenge. 固定搭配：face a challenge, meet a challenge
D(possibility)：语境句：We must consider the possibility of failure. 固定搭配：a strong possibility, rule out the possibility

questions.explanation: “rob sb. of sth.”是固定搭配，意为“剥夺某人某物”。这种追求完美的思维定势“剥夺”了作者曾经在写作中找到的快乐。
questions.supplement:
A(robs)：语境句：The disease robbed him of his ability to walk. 固定搭配：rob sb. of sth., rob a bank
B(reminds)：语境句：This song reminds me of my childhood. 固定搭配：remind sb. of sth., remind sb. to do sth.
C(warns)：语境句：The doctor warned him against smoking. 固定搭配：warn sb. about/against sth., warn sb. to do sth.
D(informs)：语境句：Please inform us of any changes in your schedule. 固定搭配：inform sb. of sth., keep sb. informed

questions.explanation: 文章主旨呼吁人们接纳不完美。所以作者指出：“在某方面不优秀也是没关系的（okay）”。这与结尾的“即使你并不伟大，也要享受过程”相呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(sad)：语境句：It is sad to see so many animals losing their habitats. 固定搭配：feel sad, a sad story
B(okay)：语境句：It's perfectly okay to ask for help when you need it. 固定搭配：be okay with, make it okay
C(intolerable)：语境句：The heat in the desert was almost intolerable. 固定搭配：find sth. intolerable, an intolerable situation
D(awesome)：语境句：The view from the top of the mountain was truly awesome. 固定搭配：look awesome, an awesome experience

questions.explanation: 空后解释说“我们往往是自己最苛刻的批评者”，这说明完美是没有客观标准的，而是“主观的（subjective）”。
questions.supplement:
A(random)：语境句：The computer generates a sequence of random numbers. 固定搭配：at random, random sample
B(temporary)：语境句：These measures are only temporary and will be changed soon. 固定搭配：temporary relief, temporary job
C(subjective)：语境句：Beauty is subjective; everyone has their own preference. 固定搭配：highly subjective, a subjective judgment
D(magical)：语境句：The children had a magical time at the theme park. 固定搭配：magical powers, a magical moment

questions.explanation: 根据上文“there’s an expectation to perform at a high level”，挑战在于在“享受（enjoyment）”和“期望（expectation）”之间找到平衡。
questions.supplement:
A(joy)：语境句：The baby brought them so much joy and happiness. 固定搭配：jump for joy, tears of joy
B(overwork)：语境句：He fell ill due to stress and overwork. 固定搭配：suffer from overwork, a result of overwork
C(enthusiasm)：语境句：She showed great enthusiasm for the new project. 固定搭配：with enthusiasm, spark enthusiasm
D(expectation)：语境句：The reality did not meet my expectations. 固定搭配：beyond expectation, meet one's expectations

section_2_word_form.passage:
Food plays a significant role in classic Chinese novels, with one of the most famous examples being Cao Xueqin’s Dream of the Red Chamber. In this 18th-century novel, food is a key part of the story, revealing details about characters [56] advancing the plot. The book’s most famous dish, a [57] (prepare) of eggplant called qiexiang (茄鲞), is a rich dish that requires [58] (day) to prepare, involving steaming eggplant ten times in soup made from old hens. The dish overwhelms the family’s poor relatives, first with envy, and later, with terrible discomfort in stomachs.
The novel provides ample inspiration for today’s cooks. Food bloggers go viral with attempts [59] (recreate) the book’s most famous dishes. “Red Chamber Banquets” pop up in theme restaurants across China, and indeed worldwide, with the dishes plated in Michelin style.
While most foods [60] (serve) in the novel are made with high skill, they are made with only a few simple seasonal ingredients. In China’s culinary culture, humble ingredients [61] (prize) because they are in season. A relative [62] brags (吹嘘) about enjoying food out of season is later revealed to have a dangerously violent temper. “A bad apple,” one might say.
Like all great literature, the enduring popularity of Dream of the Red Chamber comes from [63] (it) many layers of meanings. Readers can appreciate it more than [64] an engaging story. The same can also be said about the food. When we read about it, we can admire the cooking art, mine [65] text for historical clues, or seek double meanings in every “bite”.

questions.explanation: 设空处连接两个并列的现在分词短语“revealing details...”和“advancing the plot”，表示并列关系，应填连词and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：She sat by the window, reading a book and sipping coffee. 固定搭配：and so on, both... and...。原词其它变形：无

questions.explanation: 空前有不定冠词a，此处需要填入名词形式，表示“一种用茄子制作的菜肴/制法”，填preparation。
questions.supplement: 正确形(preparation)：语境句：Thorough preparation is the key to passing the exam. 固定搭配：in preparation for, food preparation。原词prepare其它变形：prepared(adj.), preparatory(adj.)

questions.explanation: 根据常识和语境（蒸十次），这道菜需要花费“数天”时间来准备，day是可数名词，此处需用复数形式days。
questions.supplement: 正确形(days)：语境句：It took us several days to finish the project. 固定搭配：these days, early days。原词day其它变形：daily(adj./adv.)

questions.explanation: attempt后常接动词不定式作后置定语，即attempt to do sth.（尝试做某事）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to recreate)：语境句：The artist attempted to recreate the beauty of the landscape. 固定搭配：attempt to do sth., make an attempt to do。原词recreate其它变形：recreation(n.)

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构可知，are made是谓语动词，空处需用非谓语动词作定语修饰foods。food与serve之间是逻辑被动关系，故用过去分词served。
questions.supplement: 正确形(served)：语境句：The dishes served at the banquet were absolutely delicious. 固定搭配：be served with, serve as。原词serve其它变形：service(n.), servant(n.)

questions.explanation: 此处陈述中国饮食文化中的客观事实，应用一般现在时；主语ingredients为复数，且与prize（珍视）构成被动关系，故填are prized。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are prized)：语境句：In this company, hard work and creativity are highly prized. 固定搭配：prize sth. highly, be prized for。原词prize其它变形：prizewinner(n.)

questions.explanation: 引导定语从句修饰先行词A relative（人），且在从句中作主语，故填who或that。
questions.supplement: 正确形(who/that)：语境句：The teacher who/that helped me the most is Mrs. Smith. 固定搭配：those who, anyone who。原词其它变形：无

questions.explanation: 空后为名词短语many layers of meanings，此处需要形容词性物主代词修饰名词，指代《红楼梦》这本小说的，填its。
questions.supplement: 正确形(its)：语境句：The dog wagged its tail happily when the owner returned. 固定搭配：its own, at its best。原词it其它变形：itself(pron.)

questions.explanation: 句意：读者可以将它视为“不仅仅是（more than just）”一个引人入胜的故事。填just构成常见强调搭配；也可填as，构成appreciate sth. as sth.（把...欣赏/视为...），“as more than”同样符合语法逻辑。历年高考标准答案多倾向于just或merely。
questions.supplement: 正确形(just)：语境句：This is more than just a job; it's a calling. 固定搭配：more than just, just about。正确形(as)：语境句：I appreciate his effort as a genuine attempt to help. 固定搭配：appreciate... as...。原词其它变形：无

questions.explanation: 此处特指《红楼梦》这部小说的文本，故需要用定冠词the进行特指。
questions.supplement: 正确形(the)：语境句：Please read the text on page 42 carefully. 固定搭配：the text, the same。原词其它变形：无
